newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack accelerates to high ahead of AGM.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack accelerates to high ahead of AGM.

text.p: Railtrack Plc, the UK rail network infrastructure group, saw its shares accelerate to a post-privatisation high ahead of the annual meeting on Thursday, on hopes of a positive trading statement.

Shares were up 15 pence to 800 pence per share, double the flotation value from May 1996. The market was hopeful of some positive news coming out of the annual meeting (AGM), which kicks off at 1000 GMT.
Railtrack shares have been steadier in recent weeks, after the company backed away from a possible confrontation with the rail regulator.

The group recently agreed to Rail Regulator John Swift's demands for a change to its licence conditions, avoiding uncertainty over its future and the risk of deteriorating relations with the regulator and the new Labour government.
